title: Section 6: blob download Content-Type from DB not from URL param is correct
description: blob_download_handler (lib.rs:218-234) ignores the ?accept= URL parameter for Content-Type and reads it exclusively from the DB (stored at message creation time under server control). This prevents stored XSS: a malicious peer could deliver an HTML blob and supply ?accept=text/html to have it served with text/html Content-Type in the browser's kithd origin. Reading from DB instead makes the content-type server-authoritative. A future contributor might want to honor ?accept= for client flexibility — this would be a security regression.
